trust: Only arn:aws:iam::691588646557:user/Dardan; no third-party or CI principals.

policyStatements.InspectDeploymentHosts: Read Lightsail inventory, plans, host networking state and operation results in us-east-1. The AWS service authorization reference requires Resource=* for these metadata APIs; metadata for other hosts in the region is also visible.
policyStatements.OperateOwnedDeploymentHosts: Start, stop, reboot, or obtain temporary SSH access for hosts in this account and region only when both ownership tags match. Temporary SSH responses must remain inside the deployment process.
policyStatements.VerifyDeploymentIdentity: Confirm the assumed role using STS without exposing credentials.

bootstrapSeparation: Administrator-controlled provisioning must create and tag the hosts. No create/delete/retag/firewall permissions are granted, so this role cannot claim unrelated hosts or change their network boundary.
storageAndRuntime: No S3 data, Secrets Manager retrieval, database, IAM, PassRole, or unrelated compute permissions are granted. Runtime media access and provisioning authority require separate scopes once exact resources and workflows are defined.
ci: CI trust is intentionally absent until the protected release workflow, repository and environment claims are concrete.
